verdict.rationale: Bruno documents its own ability to write docs alongside collections and publish them as shareable HTML. It also offers an embeddable README button that opens a collection in Bruno, so teams can consume published API collections and documentation. Nothing in the evidence describes a centralized, browsable catalog or portal where many teams discover APIs; Git-based collection sharing is a sharing mechanism, not a discovery portal. Missing for 10: a hosted or internal multi-API catalog with search and discovery, a portal-level publishing workflow, access control for an internal audience, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the HTML doc publishing.
